item.title: Fix bug in window.py so python3 -m unittest passes (fix-off-by-one)
item.brief:
Operator request (authenticated local operator, verbatim): "In this repository `python3 -m unittest` fails. Find and fix the bug in `window.py` so every test passes, without changing the tests, and make sure the function is correct for every input, not just the tested ones. Commit your fix."

Goal: `python3 -m unittest` passes in this repository. Acceptance criteria:
- Fix the bug in window.py (the root cause, not a special case for the tested inputs).
- Do not modify any test files.
- The function must be correct for all valid inputs, including edge cases (empty input, boundaries, single element, window size equal to or larger than the input, if applicable); reason about these explicitly and state them in the summary.
- Commit the fix on the item's branch with a clear message; do not push.
Commit identity: use the repository's configured git user only; no attribution lines mentioning Claude or generation tools.

reasons: sizer: elevated -> high; capped at medium; consider a stronger tier; unchanged

state.summary:
Fixed the off-by-one in sliding_windows (window.py). The loop ranged over len(items) - size, dropping the last window and returning [] when size == len(items). It now ranges over len(items) - size + 1. Committed as bad6013 on archon/dsewk5e1-fix-bug-in-window-py-so-python3-m-unitte (base 2392d97); not pushed. No test files changed. Checks: python3 -m unittest runs 3 tests, all OK (before the fix: 2 failures). Edge cases checked by hand: [] with size 1 gives []; [1] size 1 gives [[1]]; size > len gives []; size == len gives one window; size 3 on [1,2,3,4] gives three windows; size 0 and -1 raise ValueError. Independent read-only review of bad6013 (agent agt_01M89XD8NDMRKE4T2XNDMXDDEF) passed with no findings. Nothing left open; no servers were started. evidence.none: one-line bug fix with no visible or measurable output; the decisive result is the unittest run (3 tests OK, previously 2 failures)

pr.body: Approach: the list comprehension iterated range(len(items) - size), one start index short. Changed to range(len(items) - size + 1). Key file: window.py. Checks: python3 -m unittest passes 3/3 (before: 2 failures). Edge cases: empty input and size > len give []; size == len gives one window; size 1 gives singletons; size <= 0 still raises ValueError. Assumptions: size is a positive int, as the existing guard implies. No test files modified.
pr.summary: made sliding_windows return every window, including the last one. now returns [] only when size > len(items). before: last window dropped, whole-list window returned []; now: all windows returned.
pr.title: Fix off-by-one in sliding_windows window count
